mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with UNRATE below 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in CPI inflation signals a monetary policy response to inflationary pressures, which typically precedes a 60-day positive S&P 500 return as the market prices in a soft landing scenario.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), a decline in industrial production indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS rising and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing starts signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production signals overcapacity and slowing demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO decline during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
